{{Top|leg}}
'''Avabush spice''' was a drug obtained from the [[Avabush/Legends|avabush]] plant that that could cause sleepiness, or, when used properly, truthfulness. It grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baros]]. [[Avabush tea]] could be made from it. It was often baked into sweets<ref>[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]</ref>.
